name: pumi-office
description: Office as a UI theme: a pixel office you walk around, in Gather's style — a desk for every view (or every tab), its agent at it, and the plugins in the lobby.

appearance.label: Mode
appearance.desc: The office by day (light), at night (dark), or as the system is.

desk_per_tab.label: One desk per tab
desk_per_tab.desc: Every tab of a split view gets a desk of its own, with its agent sitting at it and its own screen, instead of one desk whose screen holds the whole view. Sitting at one opens that tab.
